byoi.headline: Keep the angle you love.
byoi.body: Turn your captured view into images and documents.

hosted.headline: Keep the angle you love.
hosted.body: Frame your model, capture the view, then choose your files.

explanation.gain: Images and documents from the exact view you framed.
explanation.howTo: Frame the model, choose Capture view, review the picture, then pick the files you want.
explanation.vsByoi: BYOI opens the documents its last build made. Hosted makes new ones from your current camera angle on request.
explanation.limits: Perspective files show what is on screen. Standard plan and elevation drawings are a separate choice.

byoi.headline: Just the part you need.
byoi.body: Isolate a part and generate documents specifically for it.

hosted.headline: Just the part you need.
hosted.body: Isolate an element before capturing your document view.

explanation.gain: Documents for just the part you care about.
explanation.howTo: Use Layers or Isolate so only that part is visible, then capture the view and request documents.
explanation.vsByoi: BYOI documents cover the whole design as built. Hosted generates them for the visible parts.
explanation.limits: What is visible decides what is included. Selecting a part alone does not hide the rest.

byoi.headline: Drawings with a tighter focus.
byoi.body: Generate plan, front, side or section drawings of visible parts.

hosted.headline: Drawings with a tighter focus.
hosted.body: Choose standard drawing views for the parts you have in view.

explanation.gain: Plan, front, side and section drawings of the parts in view.
explanation.howTo: Show the parts you want, open Documents and choose the drawing views.
explanation.vsByoi: BYOI has the drawings from its last build. Hosted makes new, focused drawings on request.
explanation.limits: Drawings are design aids, not engineering approval or permit documents.

byoi.headline: Export the parts that matter.
byoi.body: Generate STEP, IFC or GLB files for the parts in view.

hosted.headline: Export the parts that matter.
hosted.body: Hide what you do not need, then request a model export.

explanation.gain: STEP, IFC or GLB files for only the parts you need.
explanation.howTo: Hide what you do not need, open Documents and choose a model export format.
explanation.vsByoi: BYOI builds these formats for the whole design. Hosted generates them for a chosen subset.
explanation.limits: Exports cover the visible parts in the formats listed.

byoi.headline: More creating. Fewer keys.
byoi.body: Use AI without managing provider API keys.

hosted.headline: More creating. Fewer keys.
hosted.body: Your AI provider connection is managed by MakeItOurs.

explanation.gain: AI that works without provider API keys.
explanation.howTo: Sign in and start a project. MakeItOurs connects the AI for you.
explanation.vsByoi: With BYOI you bring and pay for your own AI provider account and keys.
explanation.limits: Your plan's usage limits apply. The models offered can change.

byoi.headline: Your ideas. Our infrastructure.
byoi.body: Hosted runs your projects and their compute-intensive work.

hosted.headline: Your ideas. Our infrastructure.
hosted.body: MakeItOurs manages the hosting and compute behind your projects.

explanation.gain: Hosting and the compute-heavy work run by MakeItOurs.
explanation.howTo: Ask for a change. Builds, checks and your project site run on MakeItOurs servers.
explanation.vsByoi: BYOI runs on your own GitHub and provider accounts, which you set up and look after.
explanation.limits: Build times depend on the change you ask for.

byoi.headline: Start with an idea.
byoi.body: No GitHub or AI provider account setup needed.

hosted.headline: Start with an idea.
hosted.body: Create a Hosted project without setting up developer accounts.

explanation.gain: Start designing without setting up developer accounts.
explanation.howTo: Sign in with Apple, choose a plan and create a project.
explanation.vsByoi: BYOI needs a GitHub account and an AI provider account, which the app helps you connect.
explanation.limits: You still need an Apple ID and a MakeItOurs sign-in.

byoi.headline: One plan. Wherever you make.
byoi.body: Your subscription and projects follow you on Mac and iPhone.

hosted.headline: One plan. Wherever you make.
hosted.body: Open your projects on Mac or iPhone with the same plan.

explanation.gain: One plan and the same projects on Mac and iPhone.
explanation.howTo: Sign in with the same account on both. Use Restore Purchases if a device does not show your plan.
explanation.vsByoi: BYOI projects also open on both devices through GitHub. Hosted keeps the plan and projects on your account.
explanation.limits: Manage or cancel the plan from your Apple ID subscriptions.

byoi.headline: One project. One conversation.
byoi.body: Share a project, with messages and context together.

hosted.headline: One project. One conversation.
hosted.body: Keep everyone’s ideas, messages and project context together.

explanation.gain: Share a single project, with everyone's messages and context together.
explanation.howTo: Invite people to a project. Their messages, requests and activity appear together, like a group chat.
explanation.vsByoi: BYOI collaborators share through GitHub access to the repository.
explanation.limits: Roles, removing access and whose plan is used will be explained when this ships.

byoi.headline: Everyone contributes. In order.
byoi.body: Project changes are applied one at a time to protect your work.

hosted.headline: Everyone contributes. In order.
hosted.body: Your team’s changes are applied in sequence, one at a time.

explanation.gain: Several people can ask for changes without overwriting each other.
explanation.howTo: Send your request. If someone else's change is running, yours waits its turn and you can see it queued.
explanation.vsByoi: BYOI changes land in your GitHub repository, where you manage conflicts yourself.
explanation.limits: Changes run one at a time, not as live co-editing. A change that fails leaves earlier work in place.

byoi.headline: Find a proven starting point.
byoi.body: Agents retrieve useful design patterns and code efficiently.

hosted.headline: Find a proven starting point.
hosted.body: Shared knowledge helps agents find relevant patterns and code.

explanation.gain: Agents start from proven design patterns and code.
explanation.howTo: Nothing to set up. Agents search shared examples while they plan your change.
explanation.vsByoi: BYOI agents work only from your own project.
explanation.limits: Only published designs whose owners have not opted out are used. Your designs are not used to train models.

byoi.headline: Build from your reference.
byoi.body: Hosted interprets images, guides planning and checks the result.

hosted.headline: Build from your reference.
hosted.body: Attach a reference image to guide planning and model review.

explanation.gain: A guided workflow that turns a reference image into a design.
explanation.howTo: Attach a photo or sketch to your request. Hosted plans from it and checks the model against it.
explanation.vsByoi: BYOI can accept images if your AI provider supports them. Hosted adds the guided planning and checking.
explanation.limits: Some details in an image may not be clear enough to model. You agree to how images are handled before the first upload.

byoi.headline: Pick up where you left off.
byoi.body: Hosted saves progress so interrupted work can continue.

hosted.headline: Pick up where you left off.
hosted.body: Saved checkpoints help your work continue after an interruption.

explanation.gain: Interrupted work picks up from the last saved step.
explanation.howTo: If a run is cut off or fails, open the request and choose Try again.
explanation.vsByoi: BYOI retries inside a run, but a run that stops starts over.
explanation.limits: Some failures still need a new request, and retries can use your plan's usage.

byoi.headline: An earlier version. A fresh start.
byoi.body: Return to a previously published version of your project.

hosted.headline: An earlier version. A fresh start.
hosted.body: Open Versions to review and restore a published version.

explanation.gain: Go back to an exact earlier published version.
explanation.howTo: Open Versions, choose one, review it and confirm. Hosted checks and publishes it again.
explanation.vsByoi: BYOI keeps history in your GitHub repository.
explanation.limits: Very old versions may need a tool update before they can be published again.

byoi.headline: Keep your tools in step.
byoi.body: Update your project’s CAD tools together in one step.

hosted.headline: Keep your tools in step.
hosted.body: Confirm a coordinated update to keep your CAD tools current.

explanation.gain: Your project's CAD tools kept current in one step.
explanation.howTo: When an update is offered, review it and confirm. Hosted checks the project with the new tools.
explanation.vsByoi: BYOI has Upgrade Project, which you run on your own setup.
explanation.limits: Updates never happen without your confirmation. If checks fail, your project stays on its current tools.

byoi.headline: We keep an eye on the work.
byoi.body: Failed runs alert the MakeItOurs team to investigate.

hosted.headline: We keep an eye on the work.
hosted.body: MakeItOurs receives failure alerts so we can investigate.

explanation.gain: The MakeItOurs team hears about failed runs.
explanation.howTo: Nothing to do. When a run fails, the team is alerted and looks into it.
explanation.vsByoi: With BYOI, failures show in your own GitHub and provider accounts.
explanation.limits: An alert means we look into it. It is not a guaranteed fix or response time.
